subject: Red Dragon
text: Red Dragon casts BLAZE for 50-80 damage to all party members, which AFIR reduces to 20-40 damage.

evidence.quote:
He can use BLAZE, which is like FIR3.  This does about 50-80 damage to every 
single member of your party.  Use AFIR immediately to reduce this to 20-40 
damage per character (still, ouch).

subject: Red Dragon
text: Red Dragon's physical attack deals about 30-90 damage.

evidence.quote:
His attack isn't quite as dangerous, but 
provides no relief.  He can do about 30-90 damage, much depending on who he's 
attacking.

subject: Gurgu Volcano
text: Defeating the Red Dragon rewards the party with the Flame Armor.

evidence.quote:
So, get your prize, the Flame Armor, and proceed East back to where you started 
on this level.

subject: Kary
text: Kary has around 600 HP and can hit 6 or 7 times in an attack, making INV2, RUSE, or INVS crucial.

evidence.quote:
HP-600?...Kary can get lots of 
hits on you, sometimes up to 6 or 7, so make sure you use INV2 plenty of times 
if you have it, or at least use RUSE or INVS on your weak ones.

subject: Kary
text: After defeating Kary, placing the ORB on the altar and exiting through the portal purifies the Fire Crystal.

evidence.quote:
Well, Kary should vanquish sooner or later, and when she does, put the ORB 
on the alter and exit through the portal.

subject: Sorcerer
text: Sorcerers in the Ice Cave deal 1-2 damage with physical attacks that inflict instant-death RUB.

evidence.quote:
Also in the Ice Cave are Sorcerers, who will cause you much pain.  
They do little other than attack, and when they do, they only do about 1-2 
damage.  However, the kicker is that they have RUB in their attack.

subject: Frost Wolf
text: Frost Wolves attack in packs of up to 6 and use FROST for up to 60 ice damage, requiring AICE for defense.

evidence.quote:
Their attack is mild, but 
they have a move called FROST, which causes Ice-based damage.  It can easily do 
up to 60 damage without AICE, and multiplied by 6 Frost wolves WILL cause 
problems.

subject: Ice Cave
text: The left treasure chest in the pit room of the Ice Cave contains the Flame Sword.

evidence.quote:
You will see 
3 treasure chests, partially surrounded by a number of holes.  Go to the one on 
the left, without stepping on any of the holes.  You will get a Flame Sword, 
which will help you with undead and Ice monsters.

subject: Ice Cave
text: The right chest in the pit room contains Cloth and is guarded by dangerous Mages.

evidence.quote:
Do NOT get the chest on the 
right!!!  It is guarded by several Mages who will probably wipe you out.  The 
chest only contains Cloth, such a waste.

subject: Ice Cave
text: A room on the left side of the Ice Cave contains the Ice Armor.

evidence.quote:
After 
you get out of the room, you can go to the left side and find a room with the 
Ice Armor.

subject: Ice Cave
text: A room at the bottom-left of the Ice Cave contains 8 treasure chests filled with GP, with a spiked square of Frost Wolves at the end.

evidence.quote:
room with 8 treasure chests filled with TONS of GP.  There is a spiked square 
with Frost Wolves at the end, so watch out.

subject: Eye
text: The Eye has around 150 HP and uses instant-kill attacks including RUB, petrification Glance, XXXX, and Brak.

evidence.quote:
Eye- HP about 150 or so...He will start off using RUB or similar 
spell, which will most likely knock one of your guys out right away....He can also use 
Glance, which will turn you to stone.  He also uses many auto-kill spells like 
XXXX and Brak.

subject: Ice Cave
text: Defeating the Eye guarding the middle chest allows obtaining the FLOATER.

evidence.quote:
This time, you can get the chest in the middle.  But before you can get to the 
chest...Yay!! You get the FLOATER!

subject: Airship
text: Using the FLOATER inside the desert raises the Airship.

evidence.quote:
All the way on the bottom right corner of the 
island, you will see a desert....Use the FLOATER you got from the 
Ice Cave.  Watch in awe as the Airship appears before your very eyes!

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: Entering the Castle of Ordeal courage test requires the CROWN.

evidence.quote:
As 
you enter, you will see a man that tells you that you need a CROWN to take the 
courage test (God knows why you COULDN'T have the CROWN at this point in the 
game).

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: To solve the teleporter maze, use the sofa, go right to the first teleporter, then right and up, choose the bottom teleporter, go left and down, choose the bottom teleporter, follow the hall, choose the bottom-right teleporter, and take the top hallway.

evidence.quote:
Make your way to the room on the upper left and jump in the sofa.  Here, 
you are in a room, and outside you will notice some column-shaped teleporters.  
Go out of the room and to the right to the first teleporter.  Then, right and up 
to the next one.  Now, you will have a choice.  If you pick the right one, 
you'll move on, but if you pick the wrong one, you'll teleport back to somewhere 
you were before.  Go into the bottom one.  Then, hook left and down into the 
next teleporter.  Next, you will have a choice again.  Take the one on the 
bottom.  Follow the little hallway to the next teleporter and go in.  Then, you 
will have another choice.  Take the one on the bottom right, closest to you.  
Here comes the biggest choice of all.  You will be at the beginning of 2 large 
hallways.  Take the one on top.

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: A chest guarded by a Mud Golem holds the Zeus Gauntlet, which can be selected as an item during battle to cast LIT2 infinitely at no MP cost.

evidence.quote:
There will 
be a treasure chest there.  The square next to it is spiked with a Mud Golem....You will get a 
Zeus Gauntlet for winning....In battle, go to ITEM, and select the Zeus Gauntlet and hit A.  It will 
cast LIT2 in battle.  What's better?  It doesn't use up ANY magic points and you 
can use it an INFINITE number of times!

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: After leaving the Zeus Gauntlet room, skip the teleporter directly below and take two steps right, then walk down the hallway into the correct teleporter.

evidence.quote:
Directly 
below you is a teleporter, but do NOT take it.  Take two steps to the 
right, and go down the hallway.  There will be a teleporter right below you as 
you walk straight down.  This is the one you want.

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: Past the Nightmares spiked square, chests above contain a Heal Staff, which casts HEAL in battle to restore HP to everyone.

evidence.quote:
As 
soon as you step into the room, there will be a spiked square with Nightmares 
(cousins or MadPony)....Kill them, and get the treasure chests above you.  
Among other things, you will find a Heal Staff.  
Much like the Zeus Gauntlet, you can use the Heal Staff in battle to cast HEAL 
and restore some HP to everyone.

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: Moving to the left in the upper treasure area reveals an Ice Sword and a Gold Bracelet.

evidence.quote: Head to the left, and you will find and Ice Sword and a Gold Bracelet.
